entries.name: Iron Sword
entries.flavor: A plain sword, newly forged.

entries.name: Knight's Longsword
entries.flavor: A long blade kept for the field.

entries.name: Dawnbrand
entries.flavor: A blade said to catch the first light.

entries.name: Inner Hall of the First Dawn
Beast Hollow
entries.flavor: Bones hang at the mouth, and herbs grow deeper in.

entries.name: Split Cliff
entries.flavor: The rock face is cracked, and stone herbs grow in the seams.

entries.name: Morning Dew Pool
entries.flavor: A pool of morning dew, with herbs thick along its edge.

entries.name: Alchemy Hall
entries.flavor: Alchemists brew and sell their draughts here.

entries.name: Rolls and Lessons Hall
entries.flavor: Newcomers are entered on the rolls and taught here.

entries.name: Herb Ravine
entries.flavor: Herbs cover the ravine, and beasts roam it.

entries.name: Peachwood Slope
entries.flavor: Peach trees cover the slope, with herbs beneath them.

entries.name: Sigil Spire
entries.flavor: Scrolls and charms are sold here, and implements repaired.

entries.name: Mana Herb Field
entries.flavor: A whole field planted with mana-touched herbs.

entries.name: Gatefield Arena
entries.flavor: Swordsmen test each other on the ground before the gate.

entries.name: Silverblade Hall
entries.flavor: A hall inside the gate where swordcraft is taught.

entries.name: Puppet Trial Lane
entries.flavor: Wooden puppets line the lane for newcomers to try their hand.

entries.name: Cliffside Plankway
entries.flavor: A narrow way along the cliff, where travelers are often waylaid.

entries.name: Grayhaven Escort Hall
entries.flavor: A hall whose trade is escorting travelers and goods.

entries.name: Rainlisten Herb Hall
entries.flavor: A hall for gathering and studying herbs, which also repairs gear.

entries.name: Pinewind Drill Hall
entries.flavor: A hall on the edge of town where arms are taught.

entries.name: Post Road
entries.flavor: A road with a waystation, used by every traveler.

entries.name: Broken-Wall Pit
entries.flavor: A ruin with half its wall left, where people fight in private.

entries.name: Pinewind Shrine
entries.flavor: A small shrine standing in the pines.

entries.name: Pine-Shadow Dummy Lane
entries.flavor: Wooden dummies line the lane for newcomers to practice.

entries.name: Greenbrook Ford
entries.flavor: A ford on the brook, with herbs along the bank.

entries.name: Greenbrook Ridge
entries.flavor: The ridge above the brook, where herbs grow.

entries.name: Beacon Waste
entries.flavor: Beacons stand on the waste to mark the way, and the ground can be gathered from.

entries.name: Dark Lane
entries.flavor: An unlit lane where travelers are often robbed.

entries.name: Derelict Hold
entries.flavor: The cargo hold of an abandoned ship, and not a safe one.

entries.name: Dust Plain
entries.flavor: A plain of windblown dust, crossed by beasts.

entries.name: Ring Road
entries.flavor: A road built along the ring, with the odd beast on it.

entries.name: Rusted Belt
entries.flavor: A rust-covered belt where scrap can be stripped and robbers lurk.

entries.name: Salvage Yard
entries.flavor: Hauled-in wreckage is broken down and repaired here.

entries.name: Illusion Drill Bay
entries.flavor: A bay where illusions stand in for opponents, for newcomers to try.

entries.name: Star-Chart Hall
entries.flavor: A hall where far routes and star charts are drawn.

entries.name: Orbital Berth
entries.flavor: A market where trading ships moor and accounts are settled.

entries.name: Wreck Gate
entries.flavor: A gate built of wreckage; pass through it carefully.

entries.name: Office of Rolls and Lessons
entries.flavor: The default order that enrolls newcomers and teaches them.

entries.name: Silverblade Circle
entries.flavor: A company of swordsmen who study blade and footwork.

entries.name: Alchemy Circle
entries.flavor: A company that brews and sells draughts and posts gathering errands.

entries.name: Sigil Spire Circle
entries.flavor: A company that makes and sells scrolls and charms, and repairs gear.

entries.name: Travelers' Register
entries.flavor: The default order that keeps the rolls of those passing through.

entries.flavor: An order whose trade is escorting travelers and goods.

entries.flavor: An order teaching arms on the edge of town.

entries.flavor: A gathering of people who collect and study herbs.

entries.name: Star-Chart Company
entries.flavor: A far-ranging company that maps routes and star charts.

entries.flavor: The guild that runs the berth and settles accounts.
